svg.desc: Snapshot of 18 skills on 2026-09-22. Arrows mean relies on. Dashed arrows are conditional. Grill Me and its caller paths are highlighted. Source fingerprint 4f1e007fb145bb4b8baf769918612ce3e38bc4298f13c6c171fb28f45e2e7ee3.
